snippet.title: Whoa, I Remember: The Busy World of Richard Scarry Best Reading Program Ever: Part 1
snippet.description:
(Simon & Schuster Interactive) (1996)

Come to the Busy World of Richard Scarry for hours and hours of reading fun!

Join Huckle Cat and Lowly Worm as they ask their Busytown friends to write stories for the brand new Storymobile!

This extraordinary package includes: Five locations: each with Word Play, the Find & Click Game, and 3 Phonics Activities, 15 animated on-screen stories, Story Writer, Parent online progress report, info and suggestions.
A program to accommodate multiple users while at play, children master fundamental reading readiness skills: reading, phonics, sight, word development, simple spellings, writing, listening, letters, and sounds.

Music: 
FrankJavCee - ＶａｐｏｒＴｒａｐ
FrankJavCee - Ｓｉｍｐｓｏｎｗａｖｅ １９９５
